q.line: See how they resemble one another's
stanza: Well, I met you at the blood bank
We were looking at the bags
Wondering if any of the colors
Matched any of the names we knew on the tags
You said "See, look it, that's yours
Stacked on top with your brother's
See how they resemble one another's
Even in their plastic little covers?"

partner.line: Stacked on top with your brother's

q.line: But I know our filthy hands can wash one another's
stanza: And I cannot guess what we'll discover
When we turn the dirt with our palms cupped like shovels
But I know our filthy hands can wash one another's
And not one speck will remain

q.line: May you always do for others
